Product Description

Holyswish is a pre-liquified oil pulling rinse crafted to reach the 40% of your mouth that brushing, flossing, and mouthwash miss — helping reduce gum inflammation, bleeding, and bad breath while protecting your oral microbiome. This 12-oil cold-pressed blend supports daily gum health so you can wake up with a cleaner, fresher, calmer mouth.

How to Use

Take one tablespoon (15 mL) and swish gently for 7 minutes, 2–3 times per week. Use first thing in the morning before brushing. Spit into a bin, then brush as normal. For best results, use consistently and stay hydrated throughout the day.

Why Your Routine Isn't Enough

Your brush stops at the gum margin. Floss only works between the crowns. Mouthwash rinses over the surface. That leaves 40% of your mouth untouched — exactly where the damage builds. Holyswish flows beneath the gum margin, binds to bacteria on contact, and pulls them out when you spit — gently and completely.

The Natural Way to Support Changing Gums.

1. PENETRATE

Flow below the gumline

A pre-liquified formula thin enough to seep beneath the gum margin and into the tight spaces that deepen with age — where your brush, floss, and mouthwash simply can't follow.

2. BIND

Grip harmful bacteria

The oils latch directly onto bacterial membranes on contact — locking them in place without wiping out the protective bacteria your mouth needs to stay balanced and comfortable.

3. EXTRACT

Remove & rebalance

When you spit, the bacteria leave with the oil. Not killed and left behind like chemical rinses — physically pulled out. Your microbiome stays intact, your gums stay calm and your breath stays fresh.

Frequently Asked Questions

What exactly does Holyswish do?

It's a pre-liquified oil pulling rinse that flows below the gum line, binds to harmful bacteria on contact, and physically removes them when you spit. It reaches the 40% of your mouth that brushing, flossing, and mouthwash miss.

How fast will I see results?

Most customers notice fresher breath and less morning sensitivity within the first week. Reduced bleeding typically follows within 2–3 weeks. Measurable checkup improvements usually show between 6–12 weeks of consistent use.

How do I use it?

Take one tablespoon and swish gently for 7 minutes, 2–3 times per week, before brushing. Spit into a bin, then brush as normal. No melting, no prep, no complicated routine.

Is it safe during perimenopause and HRT?

Absolutely. It contains zero alcohol, zero hormones, and zero chemicals that interact with HRT. It's specifically designed for mouths affected by hormonal changes — thinner tissue, dryness, and increased sensitivity.

Is it safe for daily use?

Yes. There's no alcohol, SLS, or harsh chemicals. The oils are cold-pressed and gentle enough for sensitive gums. Many customers with reactive tissue use it as their primary rinse without irritation.

Can I use it with Corsodyl or other mouthwash?

Yes, but most customers find they no longer need chemical mouthwash after switching. If using both, use Holyswish first, then wait 30 minutes before any other rinse.

Why not just use coconut oil from a jar?

Raw coconut oil is solid, takes 5 minutes to melt in your mouth, triggers the gag reflex, and is a single unrefined oil. Holyswish is pre-liquified, contains 12 targeted oils plus vitamins, and is ready to swish straight from the bottle.

What if it doesn't work for me?

You're covered by our 60-day money-back guarantee. No questions asked. With a 0.4% refund rate across 32,000+ customers, almost nobody uses it — but it's there if you need it.
